ceo_selection.title: Select Your CEO Class
ceo_selection.subtitle: Your class determines strategy, cost structure, and market advantages for all 16 quarters
ceo_selection.info: Selection is permanent. Each class creates a different optimal playstyle — choose your weapon.

visionary.title: The Visionary
visionary.desc: Bet the company on breakthrough R&D. Tech upgrades are cheap and you earn more EcoTech — but the factory floor costs more.
visionary.pro: EcoTech earned +25%/Q · Upgrade costs −35% · Price ceiling +10%

marketer.title: Marketing Tycoon
marketer.desc: You sell dreams, not hardware. Brand loyalty and premium pricing beat specs when you control the narrative.

operator.title: Supply Chain Master
operator.desc: Ruthless efficiency. Lean production, near-zero waste — but the market won't pay premium for efficiency.

time_freeze.choose: Decide now — timer resumes after your choice

directives.aggressive_rd_desc: Push hard on research. +3 EcoTech this quarter, production costs +10%.
directives.austerity_desc: Cut all non-essential spending. Fixed costs −15%, but team morale drops −5.
directives.market_expansion_desc: Invest in market access. Demand +12%, but unit margin shrinks.
directives.brand_campaign_desc: Launch a marketing blitz. +15 Brand Perception, costs −$5M.
directives.cost_cutting_desc: Streamline manufacturing. Unit cost −15%, but Brand Perception −5.
directives.talent_retention_desc: Invest in your team. +10 Morale, costs −$3M.
directives.premium_focus_desc: Reposition as premium brand. Price ceiling +15% this quarter.
directives.volume_play_desc: Flood the budget market. Budget demand +15%, Tech demand −5%.
directives.planned_obsolescence_desc: ⚠ DARK TACTIC: Demand +30% this quarter. 15% chance regulators catch you — lose 20% market share, −30 morale, −$10M fine.
directives.industrial_espionage_desc: ⚠ DARK TACTIC: Steal bot's tech advantage this quarter (+2 Tech). 20% chance of trade ban — zero sales next quarter.
directives.flash_sale_desc: Slash prices for volume. Demand +25% but revenue per unit ×0.80. Burn stock fast.
directives.viral_launch_desc: Drop $8M on a media blitz. Brand +20, demand +10%. Go loud or go home.
directives.headcount_freeze_desc: Stop all hiring. Fixed costs −25% this quarter. Team morale takes a −10 hit.
directives.supply_chain_deal_desc: Lock in bulk component pricing. Unit cost −15% this quarter. No morale impact.
directives.green_initiative_desc: Go public with sustainability. +3 EcoTech earned. Battery auto-upgraded to L2 if below.
